ten_customer_questions.1_what_failed: Primary 100G core transit interface HundredGigE0/0/0/1 (ifIndex=1) suffered carrier degradation/linkDown followed by eBGP peer 198.51.100.1 (AS 65002) hold-timer expiration.
ten_customer_questions.2_which_interface_changed_state: IF-MIB::ifIndex.1 (HundredGigE0/0/0/1, alias Primary-Core-Transit-AS65002) transitioned from ifOperStatus.1=1 (up) in BASELINE to 2 (down) in DEGRADE/FAILOVER and back to 1 (up) in RECOVERY.
ten_customer_questions.3_when_did_degradation_begin: Phase DEGRADE at sysUpTime.0 = 8641000 (1000 ticks / 10.0s after BASELINE sysUpTime.0 = 8640000), accompanied by IF-MIB::linkDown (1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3) and ifInErrors.1 jumping from 0 to 48.
ten_customer_questions.4_did_bgp_fail: Yes. In FAILOVER (sysUpTime.0 = 8642000), BGP4-MIB::bgpBackwardTransition (1.3.6.1.2.1.15.7.2) fired and polled bgpPeerState.198.51.100.1 dropped from 6 (established) to 1 (idle) with bgpPeerLastError.198.51.100.1 = 0400 (Hold Timer Expired).
ten_customer_questions.6_did_routing_move_to_different_next_hop: Yes. Polled IP-MIB::ipRouteNextHop.0.0.0.0 moved from 198.51.100.1 (ipRouteIfIndex.0.0.0.0=1) in BASELINE/DEGRADE to backup peer 198.51.100.2 (ipRouteIfIndex.0.0.0.0=2, HundredGigE0/0/0/2, AS 65003) in FAILOVER.
ten_customer_questions.7_did_snmp_polling_corroborate_notificat: Yes. Every notification (linkDown, bgpBackwardTransition, linkUp, bgpEstablished) agreed 100% with the polled MIB-II / IF-MIB / IP-MIB / BGP4-MIB state in the same phase.
ten_customer_questions.8_did_the_interface_recover: Yes. In RECOVERY (sysUpTime.0 = 8643500), IF-MIB::linkUp (1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.4) was observed and polled ifOperStatus.1 returned to 1 (up).
ten_customer_questions.9_did_bgp_reestablish: Yes. In RECOVERY (sysUpTime.0 = 8643500), BGP4-MIB::bgpEstablished (1.3.6.1.2.1.15.7.1) was observed, polled bgpPeerState.198.51.100.1 returned to 6 (established), bgpPeerLastError.198.51.100.1 cleared to 0000, and bgpPeerFsmEstablishedTransitions.198.51.100.1 incremented from 1 to 2.
ten_customer_questions.10_was_original_route_restored: Yes. In RECOVERY, polled IP-MIB::ipRouteNextHop.0.0.0.0 returned to 198.51.100.1 over ipRouteIfIndex.0.0.0.0=1 with metric 10.
